gauntlet: gate=chase-bug/verdict-menu recommended=3

### Context

Requesting `/widgets/` locally returns page not found (404), and a falsification test confirmed exact path matching as the cause. A search found no earlier report of this problem.

### What is broken

Opening `/widgets/` shows page not found (404) instead of the widgets page, while `/widgets` loads normally (status 200).

### Why it is broken

The part that matches URLs to pages compares paths character for character without cleaning them up first. The extra trailing slash in `/widgets/` therefore matches no page (`src/router.ts:88`).

### How to fix it

Strip the trailing slash before comparing paths so both URLs reach the widgets page. This is a small change to one comparison, plus a regression test. Choose hotfix because the change is that small and every safety check passes.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After moved draft-asks-reporter from fails to holds purely by adding the sectioned shape: Before asked for browser and version in a single blockquote paragraph with no What happens next heading, so the fact as written could not hold, while After places the ask under that heading, keeps the `send it` confirmation outside the draft, and phrases delivery as a future action rather than a push claim. Nothing Before kept was lost: both reports stay unfenced, well under 180 words (Context is two lines), the menu keeps rows 1.-4. with one [recommended] on hotfix and the eligibility line after Pick one:, and both checkpoints end at the envelope. The only soft spot is plain-reader: After explains 404 and 200 on first use (an improvement over Before), but 'falsification test' in Context is still a bare term; a phrase like 'a test designed to disprove the cause' on first use, and keeping 'because' as the single closing clause in How to fix it (which After already does), would lock the contract in without risking that fact.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: After keeps every fact Before kept and picks up two: the sectioned shape gives the reporter draft an explicit What happens next section with the browser/version ask, and the What is broken / Why it is broken prose explains 404 as 'page not found' and the comparison bug as a trailing-slash mismatch, where Before used bare '404', '200' and 'normalization'. Three things in After are weaker than Before without any fact flipping yet: the confirmation is a bare 'send it' line rather than an instruction ('Reply with the exact text `send it` to post this comment'), which a reader could mistake for the model issuing the send; the menu is wrapped in a ```text fence and row 3 is pre-ticked [x] as if already chosen, which the contract says to preserve as [ ] with [recommended]; and the eligibility line dropped 'six' from 'all six predicates pass'. Suggested wording for the shared contract: 'Below the report, echo the menu verbatim and unfenced, rows unticked, followed by the eligibility line; for drafts, end with the literal prompt line asking the human to reply `send it` to post.'
